info.title: Skyline.DataMiner.CICD.Tools.DmUpgradeStorage
info.description: This .NET tool allows you to manage .dmupgrade packages in storage.

options.name: --debug
options.description: Indicates the tool should write out debug logging.

options.name: --minimum-log-level
options.description: Indicates what the minimum log level should be. Default is Information

commands.name: upload
commands.description: Upload a dmupgrade package to the storage.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: The connection string of the blob storage to connect to. Not needed when using the account name and key. Will take precedence over account name and key. Can also be provided via an environment variable: 'BLOBSTORAGE__CONNECTIONSTRING'

options.name: --account-name
options.description: The account name of the blob storage to connect to. Not needed when using the connection string. Can also be provided via an environment variable: 'BLOBSTORAGE__ACCOUNTNAME'

options.name: --account-key
options.description: The account key of the blob storage to connect to. Not needed when using the connection string. Can also be provided via an environment variable: 'BLOBSTORAGE__ACCOUNTKEY'

options.name: --container-name
options.description: The container of the blob storage. Can also be provided via an environment variable: 'BLOBSTORAGE__CONTAINERNAME'

options.name: --dmupgrade-file
options.description: The file that will be created that holds the information.

options.name: --version
options.description: Represents the DataMiner version. Expected format: X.X.X.X

options.name: --build-number
options.description: Represents the build number of the upgrade package.

options.name: --cu
options.description: Represents the CU number.

options.name: --gerrit-id
options.description: Represents the gerrit ID.

options.name: --patch-set
options.description: Represents the patch set number of the gerrit item.

options.name: --package-type
options.description: What type of package is this?

options.name: --upgrade-type
options.description: What type of upgrade is this?

options.name: --output-file
options.description: Contains the unique identifier of the uploaded package. Will be created or overwritten.

options.name: --package-name
